description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write), and only the site owner's is accepted (the Fabric Agents brief automation runs as him). Adds one brief to the pool get_brief offers engineers, first and matched to their work: topic, why (the evidence), angle, sources, target_query, for_author. Refused with the reason, nothing stored, when a live post or an idea in flight covers it, an open proposal already is it, or today's 3 are used; the same topic again is the same brief. Drafts and publishes nothing; no model.

angle.description: What the post argues or shows, and for which reader

for_author.description: An engineer from the author registry, when the work is theirs; leave out to offer it to whoever's work fits

target_query.description: The search the post should answer, when there is one

topic.description: The post's subject in a few words (8 to 140 characters)

why.description: The evidence: the TechFabric work it comes from (a repository, a project, a published post), or the search data (query, monthly volume, who ranks). Never a guess

name: propose_brief
title: Propose a brief
